audit.why: Her CC is real (W root 450 range, point-blank R) and punishes greedy dives, but she has no kill pressure and Naafiri dictates from 3. Difficulty moved to EVEN 5.5/10 to match the data; carry threat left at 8.5/10 — her teamfight R remains the danger.
